answer_1.quote: We present EDGE, an exemplar-based generative dialogue model ... We compare EDGE with baseline models on open-domain conversations in Dailydialog dataset, and report results in terms of human‑rated and automatic metrics ...

answer_2.quote: We also evaluate the models using an unreferenced automated evaluation metric MaUdE ... We calculate Dist‑n (Dist‑2, Dist‑3) and report BLEU‑2 and Sem‑Cov scores.

answer_4.quote: Annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk platform rated the responses of the models for 100 randomly selected test contexts on a scale of 1 to 3 ... criteria: Coherent, Interesting, Fluent, Consistent, Uses semantics. We also asked annotators to rate Coherence, Follows intent, and Engagement for anti‑scam responses.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were shown a conversational context and responses to rate, with detailed instructions and examples for each criterion.
